evals.prompt: Set up a new ALAC and Atmos Apple Music playlist library on an x86_64 Linux host for Jellyfin.
evals.expected: Discovers compatible releases, verifies APK libraries, separates codec roots, snapshots before download, validates codecs, and excludes credentials from support artifacts.

evals.prompt: Update my existing playlist mirror from yesterday's snapshot without downloading unchanged tracks.
evals.expected: Fetches and validates the live Apple Music playlist before loading the old snapshot as a baseline, diffs catalog IDs, downloads only added URLs, removes only explicit removed IDs, rebuilds ordered playlists, verifies both libraries, promotes the snapshot after success, reports playlist changes separately from per-codec outcomes, and leaves no changes directory in the media library.

evals.prompt: Package this setup so another agent can restore it, but exclude every credential and account artifact.
evals.expected: Includes only non-reproducible inputs, the current snapshot, dependency references, and checksums while excluding credentials and reproducible files.
